title: 250. Maintaining long distance friendships in our 20s

sentences.en: This is an iHeart Podcast, Guaranteed Human.
sentences.zh: 这是一个iHeart播客，保证真人录制。

sentences.en: I've been really trying to prioritize my health in a realistic way this year, and something that has kept me really motivated is my WHOOP.
sentences.zh: 今年我一直在以一种切合实际的方式优先关注自己的健康，而让我保持动力的一个重要法宝就是我的WHOOP手环。

sentences.en: I am such a data person, which is why I love WHOOP, because I can genuinely see why my body feels differently depending on the day, why I'm running differently,
sentences.zh: 我是一个非常注重数据的人，这也是我热爱WHOOP的原因，因为我能真正看懂为什么我的身体在不同的日子会有不同的感觉，为什么我跑步的状态会有所不同，

sentences.en: why I'm maybe less focused.
sentences.zh: 为什么我有时会难以集中注意力。

sentences.en: WHOOP effortlessly tracks my sleep, it tracks my strain, my recovery, my stress, and most importantly, my overall health.
sentences.zh: WHOOP能够轻松追踪我的睡眠、运动强度、恢复情况、压力水平，最重要的是，还有我的整体健康状况。

sentences.en: And it just gives me all that data and all those patterns so I can make better decisions, which includes knowing when to go easy and knowing when to go hard.
sentences.zh: 它为我提供所有的这些数据和规律，帮助我做出更好的决策，包括知道什么时候该放松，什么时候该拼搏。

sentences.zh: 新会员在正式订阅会员服务之前，可以先通过30天免费试用体验WHOOP。

sentences.en: That's join.whoop.com slash psychology for your free month of WHOOP.
sentences.zh: 访问 join.whoop.com 斜杠 psychology，即可免费体验一个月的WHOOP。

sentences.zh: 你有什么绝对不会扔掉的珍贵物品吗？

sentences.zh: 一张电影票、一张登机牌，或者某种除了你之外谁也无法理解意义的东西。

sentences.en: Sam explores the memories, obsessions, and tiny treasures that become part of who you are.
sentences.zh: 山姆探索了那些构成你一部分的记忆、执念以及微小珍宝。

sentences.en: Charmed is warm, it's funny, it's nostalgic, and just full of the little moments and memories that make life matter.
sentences.zh: 《迷人》温暖、风趣、充满怀旧感，里面全都是那些让生活变得有意义的微小瞬间和记忆。

sentences.en: Charmed, with Sam Todd, stories worn to tell with Pandora.
sentences.zh: 由潘多拉冠名播出的《迷人》（山姆·托德主持），带你聆听那些值得诉说的故事。

sentences.en: Listen now on iHeart.
sentences.zh: 立即在iHeart上收听。

sentences.en: Hello, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the show.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到节目。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到本播客。

sentences.en: New listeners, old listeners, wherever you are in the world, it is so great to have you here back for another episode as we break down the psychology of our 20s.
sentences.zh: 新听众、老听众，无论你身处世界的哪一个角落，非常高兴你能回来收听新的一期节目，和我们一起剖析二十多岁时的心理学。

sentences.en: I want to begin this episode with a question.
sentences.zh: 我想以一个问题来开始这期节目。

sentences.en: How many friendships do you have with people who don't live in the same state, same city, even the same country as you?
sentences.zh: 你有多少朋友不住在你的同一个州、同一个城市，甚至不是同一个国家？

sentences.en: Quickly do the math.
sentences.zh: 快算一算。

sentences.en: How many long-distance friendships do you have?
sentences.zh: 你有多少段异地友谊？

sentences.en: So the average number for people in their 20s is between two to five people.
sentences.zh: 对于二十多岁的人来说，这个平均数字大约在两到五人之间。

sentences.en: Two to five of the people we consider friends are people who we might not see for months on end, sometimes even years.
sentences.zh: 在我们认为的朋友中，有两到五人可能是我们好几个月、甚至有时好几年都见不到一面的人。

sentences.en: They are the people that we stay connected to via text messages and TikToks and rushed voice notes on the train,
sentences.zh: 他们是我们通过短信、TikTok、在地铁上发得急急忙忙的语音消息，

sentences.en: FaceTime calls when we can, and it can be really, really difficult to sustain those relationships.
sentences.zh: 以及一有机会就打FaceTime视频电话来维持联系的人，而维系这些关系可能会非常非常困难。

sentences.en: Only about 50% of long-distance friendships are successful in the long-term, which, you know what, it's either very good odds or very terrifying odds, depending on how we see it.
sentences.zh: 长途友谊只有大约50%能长期维持下去，你知道吗，这要么是个很好的概率，要么是个极其吓人的概率，取决于我们怎么看它。

sentences.en: And despite that, we go into our long-distance friendships with so much optimism and hope because we really care about these people.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，我们对待异地友谊时依然充满了乐观和希望，因为我们真的很在乎这些人。

sentences.en: And, you know, what else are we meant to do?
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我们还能怎么办呢？

sentences.en: If we said goodbye to every single friendship that was inconvenient or every single friendship where distance made it difficult, we would be pretty lonely people because distance,
sentences.zh: 如果我们对每一段带来不便的友谊，或者每一段因距离而变得艰难的友谊都说再见，那我们会成为非常孤独的人，因为距离，

sentences.en: whether it's physical or emotional, is kind of a fact of life.
sentences.zh: 无论是物理上的还是情感上的，可以说是生活的一种常态。

sentences.en: It's a fact of relationships.
sentences.zh: 这也是人际关系的一种常态。

sentences.en: There are periods of great closeness and then periods where the connection kind of wanes.
sentences.zh: 总会有一段时期无比亲密，然后又会有一段时期，这种联系渐渐淡去。

sentences.en: And our 20s are definitely the decade for learning that lesson.
sentences.zh: 我们的二十岁绝对是用来学习这一课的十年。

sentences.en: In my mind, for the first 18 years of our lives, right, we are typically never more than, I would say, 30 minutes away from our friends.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，在我们生命的前18年里，对吧，我们通常离朋友的距离最多也就是，我可以说，30分钟的车程。

sentences.en: We also tend to see each other probably five days a week at school.
sentences.zh: 我们在学校里大概也是一周五天都能见到彼此。

sentences.en: And then after we leave high school, we have that first exodus or that first shift of navigating long-distance friendships when we all kind of scatter for college
sentences.zh: 而在我们离开高中之后，当大家都为了上大学而各奔东西，

sentences.en: or we stay in the same place.
sentences.zh: 或者留在同一个地方时，我们迎来了第一波出走，也就是开始适应异地友谊的第一次转变。

sentences.en: Then we might make new friends at university and often we become even closer with these people.
sentences.zh: 接下来，我们可能会在大学里结交新朋友，而且通常我们会和这些人变得更加亲密。

sentences.en: We live with them.
sentences.zh: 我们和他们住在一起。

sentences.en: We experience many of our firsts with them until we are hit with that second round of distance post-graduation.
sentences.zh: 我们和他们一起经历许多人生中的“第一次”，直到我们毕业后遭遇第二波距离的冲击。

sentences.en: Right when, you know, typically we're often at our peak closeness with people, the relationships start to disperse.
sentences.zh: 就在你懂的，通常正是我们与人最亲密的高峰期，这些关系开始四散分散。

sentences.en: I think this is definitely the period where our friendships are tested the most and they become less convenient.
sentences.zh: 我认为这绝对是我们的友谊经受最大考验、也变得最不方便的时期。

sentences.en: It's a bit of a universal experience in my mind, a bit of a rite of passage.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，这多少算是一种普遍的经历，也算是一种成长的洗礼。

sentences.en: We move from high school to university and then we move for our careers and then we move just for fun.
sentences.zh: 我们从高中走到大学，然后为了事业搬迁，接着又单纯为了好玩而搬家。

sentences.en: And it seems like everyone we know and love at times is kind of sprawled across the world and we're living these very distinct, separate lives.
sentences.zh: 而且有时候，似乎我们认识和深爱的每一个人都散落在世界各地，我们过着各自非常独特、截然不同的人生。

sentences.en: Of course, we still have the friends that have stayed in the same place or who have moved with us.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们依然有那些留在原地或跟我们一起搬家的朋友。

sentences.en: But for those long-distance friendships, things do shift and yet we still really want to be part of each other's reality.
sentences.zh: 但对于那些异地友谊来说，情况确实发生了变化，然而我们依然非常渴望成为彼此现实生活的一部分。

sentences.en: We don't want to give up the friendship.
sentences.zh: 我们不想放弃这段友谊。

sentences.en: So today I want to talk about why we don't have to and how we can make it work.
sentences.zh: 所以今天我想聊聊为什么我们不必放弃，以及我们该如何让它维持下去。

sentences.en: I also really want to explore what exactly happens to a relationship when we add in distance and how to make sure that those long-distance friendships continue to be fulfilling,
sentences.zh: 我还想深入探讨，当我们加入距离这一要素时，一段关系到底会发生什么变化，以及如何确保这些异地友谊能够继续保持充实、

sentences.en: they continue to be deep and vulnerable and incredible.
sentences.zh: 继续保持深度、脆弱感和不可思议的美好。

sentences.en: You know, I have some of my own strategies and I've really come up with a bit of an essential formula for maintaining long-distance friendships.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我有自己的一些策略，并且我确实总结出了一套维护异地友谊的根本公式。

sentences.en: Plus, you all the listeners were kind enough to provide your own tips and tricks that have helped you through the years.
sentences.zh: 此外，你们所有的听众也非常慷慨地分享了各自在这些年里帮助过你们的小贴士和诀窍。

sentences.en: So I'm excited to hear from some of you.
sentences.zh: 所以我很高兴能听到其中一些人的分享。

sentences.en: Let me just say this episode is coming at a great time for me.
sentences.zh: 请允许我先说，这期节目对我来说来得太是时候了。

sentences.en: This year, I went through a period where three of my closest friends all moved overseas in pretty quick succession.
sentences.zh: 今年，我经历了一段时期，我最要好的三个朋友都在相当短的时间内相继搬到了海外。

sentences.en: So it has definitely been a year of playing a lot of phone tag and just adjusting to this new reality with them.
sentences.zh: 所以这绝对是经常玩“电话留言乒乓”、并且努力适应与他们这种新现实的一年。

sentences.en: I also have a lot of really important friends with whom, you know, I haven't lived in the same city as for 13, 10, 5 years or so.
sentences.zh: 我也有很多非常重要的朋友，你知道的，我已经有13年、10年、5年左右没有和他们在同一个城市生活过了。

sentences.en: So I was definitely paying pretty close attention to what you guys had to say, what you've learned from your own experiences.
sentences.zh: 所以我一直在非常仔细地倾听你们大家想说的话，听你们从自己的经历中学到了什么。

sentences.en: And of course, the research.
sentences.zh: 当然，还有研究成果。

sentences.en: I also want us to leave some space to consider what happens when long-distance friendships aren't working out and when they become pretty strained.
sentences.zh: 我也希望我们能留出一些空间来思考，当异地友谊不再顺利、关系变得相当紧张时会发生什么。

sentences.en: You know, when exactly is it time to release someone?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，到底什么时候才是放手让某人离开的时候？

sentences.en: When is it time to grieve a friendship that didn't survive the long-distance phase?
sentences.zh: 什么时候该为一段没能熬过异地阶段的友谊感到悲伤？

sentences.en: We've got to talk about that as well amongst all the other positive, optimistic things that we'll cover.
sentences.zh: 在探讨我们所要涵盖的所有其他积极、乐观的事情之余，我们也必须谈谈这个。

sentences.en: With all that in mind, there is so much psychology, so much advice, so much evidence to talk about today.
sentences.zh: 带着所有这些想法，今天有太多的心理学知识、太多的建议、太多的证据需要我们去探讨。

sentences.en: So without further ado, let's get into it.
sentences.zh: 所以废话不多说，我们这就切入正题。

sentences.en: Taking a close relationship and adding distance can cause a lot of emotional, social, relational changes.
sentences.zh: 把一段亲密的关系加上距离，可能会引发许多情感上、社交上以及关系层面的变化。

sentences.en: And the biggest one, the biggest contributor to the difference that we notice, I think comes down to a lack of convenience, a lack of proximity and a decrease in shared memories.
sentences.zh: 而其中最大的变化，也就是导致我们所察觉到的差异的最大诱因，我认为归根结底在于便利性的缺乏、地理邻近性的缺乏以及共同记忆的减少。

sentences.en: All of which are very well-known, crucial elements of friendship.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都是广为人知的、对友谊至关重要的元素。

sentences.en: I will say, we do know that these ingredients are really important, but they're especially important when a friendship is just getting started and in its infancy.
sentences.zh: 我得说，我们确实知道这些成分非常重要，但当一段友谊刚刚开始、还处于萌芽期时，它们尤其重要。

sentences.en: That is why relationships can still survive long distance when they've been around for a while.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么如果关系已经维持了一段时间，在面对异地时仍然能够存活下来。

sentences.en: You know, if we didn't have the convenience, proximity and shared memories at the beginning, then the relationships are more likely to fail.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果我们在最初缺乏便利性、邻近性和共同记忆，那么这些关系就更有可能失败。

sentences.en: But normally when we decide to be friends and continue a friendship with someone who is moving away or when we're moving away, it's because we've already got this foundation
sentences.zh: 但通常当我们决定与一个正在搬走或我们即将搬走的人做朋友并继续这段友谊时，是因为我们已经建立起了这样一种基础：

sentences.en: of trust, of familiarity, of similarity and of some other essential element.
sentences.zh: 充满信任、熟悉感、相似性以及其他一些必不可少的元素。

sentences.en: This element of knowledge and being seen by the other person that makes us feel like to lose them would almost be to lose a part of ourselves.
sentences.zh: 这种彼此了解并被对方看见的元素，让我们觉得失去对方几乎就像是失去了自己的一部分。

sentences.en: So it's really difficult when a friendship is impacted by distance, but it's not a death sentence by any means, especially to establish friendships.
sentences.zh: 因此，当友谊受到距离冲击时确实非常艰难，但这绝不是死刑，尤其是对已经建立稳固的友谊而言。

sentences.en: Despite that, it does make it harder to connect.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，这确实让建立联系变得更加困难。

sentences.en: When we are closer, we can just naturally do more things with our friends and we can do more of those filler activities.
sentences.zh: 当我们离得很近时，我们可以很自然地和朋友一起做更多的事情，我们可以做更多那些琐碎的日常活动。

sentences.en: And it's those filler activities that really help us bond and make shared memories.
sentences.zh: 正是这些琐碎的活动真正帮助我们建立了纽带并创造了共同记忆。

sentences.en: shared memories are key for long-term social bonding.
sentences.zh: 共同记忆是长期社会连结的关键。

sentences.en: There was a 2022 study that found that the more autobiographical and specific memories that we share with others, the closer we tend to feel.
sentences.zh: 2022年的一项研究发现，我们与他人分享的自传体和具体记忆越多，我们往往就会感到彼此越亲密。

sentences.en: And what that essentially means is that the more moments that our friends are around for and the more moments that we can look back on and see our friend in the background
sentences.zh: 而这本质上的意思是，我们的朋友参与的时刻越多，我们能够回想起来并且在背景中、或者在我们的身侧看到朋友身影的时刻越多，

sentences.en: or by our side, the greater our level of intimacy.
sentences.zh: 我们的亲密程度就越高。

sentences.en: It's, you know, really wonderful when we do get to see our long-distance best friends for a weekend or at a friend's wedding or at a big celebration.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，当我们能和异地的死党在周末聚聚、或者在朋友的婚礼上、在大庆典上相聚时，这真的是一件非常美妙的事情。

sentences.en: And of course, we're going to take any of the time that we can get with them.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们会抓住任何能和他们在一起的时间。

sentences.en: But in my opinion, the thing that I really miss the most is the errands.
sentences.zh: 但在我看来，我真正最怀念的其实是那些琐碎的跑腿差事。

sentences.en: It's running into each other on the street.
sentences.zh: 是在街上偶遇。

sentences.en: It's like grabbing a quick coffee.
sentences.zh: 是一起顺便喝杯快咖啡。

sentences.en: The, you know, want to get a drink text, knowing that you can both be ready in 10 minutes.
sentences.zh: 是发一句“想不想喝一杯”的短信，深知你们俩都可以在10分钟内准备好出门。

sentences.en: It's that instant gratification of having that person around and knowing that they could be at your house, you know, in a second.
sentences.zh: 那种身边有个人陪伴、并且知道他们可以在一秒钟内赶到你家的即时满足感。

sentences.en: I reminisce on this all the time with my friend Erin, who I talk about so often on the show.
sentences.zh: 我经常和我的朋友艾琳一起回忆这些，我在节目里经常提到她。

sentences.en: When we lived in Canberra together and it's been four years now since that was the case, but when we did live only 100 metres away from each other, my favourite thing
sentences.zh: 当我们一起住在堪培拉的时候——距离那是四年前的事了，但当年我们真的只相距100米住在一起时，我和她最喜欢做的事情

sentences.en: to do with her would be grocery shopping.
sentences.zh: 就是去超市买菜。

sentences.en: And that is something that is so boring and plain, but we would walk up and down the aisles for hours and hours just chatting and then we would come home and I'd sit on her couch
sentences.zh: 那是一件非常无聊和平淡的事情，但我们可以一圈又一圈地在过道里走上好几个小时，只是不停地聊天，然后我们回到家，我坐在她的沙发上

sentences.en: while she cleaned.
sentences.zh: 看着她打扫卫生。

sentences.en: There was no fanfare.
sentences.zh: 没有什么盛大的场面。

sentences.en: It was just so simple.
sentences.zh: 一切就是那么简单。

sentences.en: It was so everyday.
sentences.zh: 就是那么日常。

sentences.en: And at the time, I did, you know, I didn't realise how nostalgic I would one day be for that opportunity to just have that everyday closeness with someone and especially
sentences.zh: 而在当时，我，你知道的，我并没有意识到有朝一日我会多么怀念那种能够与某人——尤其是与这样一位好朋友——拥有日常亲密感的机遇。

sentences.en: with such a good friend.
sentences.zh: 尤其对象是这样一位好朋友。

sentences.en: There's also something to be said for the value of in-person contact, right?
sentences.zh: 线下接触的价值也是不容忽视的，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, nothing beats it.
sentences.zh: 比如，没有什么能比得过它。

sentences.en: Even as we look for online substitutions and solutions, getting to just see your friend and give them a big hug and just talk to them and hear their laughter like as you see it
sentences.zh: 即便我们在寻找网上的替代品和解决方案，能够亲眼见到你的朋友，给他们一个大大的拥抱，只是跟他们聊天，听着他们的笑声，就像你亲眼看到的那样，

sentences.en: and responding to the same things, experiencing the same things, that's pretty special.
sentences.zh: 对同样的事情作出反应，经历同样的事情，那是非常特别的。

sentences.en: And it goes without saying that a relationship that is defined by solely online interactions, it can feel slightly colder, it can feel a little bit more plain, but that just makes
sentences.zh: 不言而喻，一段完全由线上互动界定的关系，可能会感觉稍微冷淡一些，可能会显得更加平淡，但这只会让你们

sentences.en: the time that you do spend together, you know, physically a lot more special.
sentences.zh: （在现实中）真正共度的时光变得格外特别。

sentences.en: And I like to think about, you know, how many people were able to make friendships and who made relationships that survived for decades doing long distance before technology.
